findings.explanation: A FROM instruction with a readable base reference was found.
limitations: Dockerfile instructions are parsed as text; no image build, container execution, shell command, or network lookup is performed.
This is a limited structural check, not complete Dockerfile syntax validation.
findings.name: FROM Instruction
findings.recommendation: No action required for this structural rule.
findings.suggestedAction: No action required for this structural rule.

findings.explanation: At least one FROM instruction explicitly uses the :latest tag.
limitations: Dockerfile instructions are parsed as text; no image build, container execution, shell command, or network lookup is performed.
No registry lookup was performed; a tag does not guarantee an immutable image.
findings.name: Base Image Tag
findings.recommendation: Pin a specific version or digest instead of :latest for reproducible builds.
findings.suggestedAction: Pin a specific version or digest instead of :latest for reproducible builds.

findings.explanation: No explicit USER instruction was found in the final stage chain, so the effective runtime user is unknown.
limitations: Dockerfile instructions are parsed as text; no image build, container execution, shell command, or network lookup is performed.
The base image user cannot be determined from the submitted Dockerfile.
Missing USER is not reported as a definite root execution.
findings.name: Final Stage User
findings.recommendation: Set an explicit non-root USER when the base image user is not guaranteed.
findings.suggestedAction: Set an explicit non-root USER when the base image user is not guaranteed.

findings.explanation: No explicit WORKDIR was found in the final stage chain.
limitations: Dockerfile instructions are parsed as text; no image build, container execution, shell command, or network lookup is performed.
The working directory inherited from the base image cannot be determined from the submitted Dockerfile.
findings.name: Working Directory
findings.recommendation: Set an explicit WORKDIR so relative paths are predictable.
findings.suggestedAction: Set an explicit WORKDIR so relative paths are predictable.

findings.explanation: No explicit CMD or ENTRYPOINT was found in the final stage chain.
limitations: Dockerfile instructions are parsed as text; no image build, container execution, shell command, or network lookup is performed.
A missing explicit command does not prove that the container cannot start; the base image may define CMD or ENTRYPOINT.
findings.name: Startup Command
findings.recommendation: Define a startup command when the base image does not provide a suitable one.
findings.suggestedAction: Define a startup command when the base image does not provide a suitable one.

findings.explanation: A broad build-context copy was found and no .dockerignore file was supplied.
limitations: Dockerfile instructions are parsed as text; no image build, container execution, shell command, or network lookup is performed.
Build-context exclusions could not be verified because .dockerignore was not available.
COPY . . is not treated as insecure by itself.
findings.name: COPY and ADD Usage
findings.recommendation: Consider adding a .dockerignore file or copying only the required paths.
findings.suggestedAction: Consider adding a .dockerignore file or copying only the required paths.

findings.explanation: An explicit broad permission pattern was found.
limitations: Dockerfile instructions are parsed as text; no image build, container execution, shell command, or network lookup is performed.
Only explicit chmod and COPY --chmod patterns are detected; arbitrary shell scripts are not interpreted.
A broad permission setting is not claimed to be exploitable in every context.
findings.name: Dangerous Permissions
findings.recommendation: Use the narrowest permissions that allow the application to run.
findings.suggestedAction: Use the narrowest permissions that allow the application to run.

findings.explanation: No explicit HEALTHCHECK was found in the final stage chain.
limitations: Dockerfile instructions are parsed as text; no image build, container execution, shell command, or network lookup is performed.
An effective runtime health check may be inherited from the base image and was not verified.
findings.name: Health Check
findings.recommendation: Define a HEALTHCHECK CMD if the deployment platform should evaluate container health.
findings.suggestedAction: Define a HEALTHCHECK CMD if the deployment platform should evaluate container health.
